column1: # Authored from the 2024 PHB SRD (CC-BY 4.0). Spot-check against the printed PHB — wording may have been adjusted in errata.

column2: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.
You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
column4: Auto adds resistance to poison damage

column2: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.
column4: Auto increases max HP by 1, plus another +1 per character level

column2: As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching such a surface to use this Tremorsense. The stone can be natural or worked. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
column4: Set Tremorsense to 60ft (active for 10 minutes; uses Bonus Action)

column2: You can speak, read, and write Common and Dwarvish.
column4: Auto adds Common, Dwarvish to languages
